entries.388218d6f66546d4: From feed manufacturing through breeder hen rearing, chick production, broiler rearing, chicken processing, processed food manufacturing and restaurant operations, it carries out everything in-house within the group, and supplies chicken raised without medication.
entries.3dddb18644f1e6d3: The group has an integrated system that covers everything within the group, from feed manufacturing, rearing, chicken processing and processed foods to restaurants, and it achieves drug-free rearing through its proprietary henhouse environmental control technology and in-house manufactured feed. The group also has a recycling system that converts chicken waste into biomass energy and reuses inedible parts as raw materials for feed and fertilizer.
entries.48d66abd02f3b351: Integrated structure from feed to restaurants
entries.5c2b2fcf9b7821f7: This segment manufactures and sells chicken meat from broilers raised at company-operated fattening facilities, and processed foods such as karaage and chicken nuggets made from that chicken. In addition to achieving drug-free rearing, it also manufactures and sells Shirasu balloon and zeolite products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥24,674 million, up 11.2% year on year.

entries.e075abbd39860fe1: The company is headquartered in Kagoshima City, Kagoshima Prefecture, and its main business is providing chicken meat needed in daily life to general consumers. The group consists of the company, seven consolidated subsidiaries (AXYZ Foods Co., Ltd., AXYZ Chemical Co., Ltd., Kinkowan Shiryo Co., Ltd., Minami Kyushu Chikusan Co., Ltd., Gumyo Farm Co., Ltd., IM Poultry Co., Ltd. and Jōyama Service Co., Ltd.) and one affiliate (Minami Kyushu Biomass Co., Ltd.). The number of employees for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was 1,290. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.e946539289263aa2: As its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company aims to steadily expand production and sales volume and to secure and develop human resources, and its policy is to build or expand breeder farms and fattening facilities, hatcheries, processing plants and other facilities, while maintaining the group's integrated system in the area centered on its feed mills.
